Haxorus

Dragon

Unova · Generation 5

Haxorus is a Dragon-type Axe Jaw Pokémon first found in Unova (Generation 5). It stands 1.8 m tall and weighs 105.5 kg. It evolves from Fraxure. Its highest base stat is Attack (147), with a base stat total of 540.
